steps.title: Open the Desk page
steps.narration: The Desk page loads with all sections in place. This regression pass verifies that backend changes to the data pipeline don't break the UI.
steps.point_out: The Playbook Signals heading is visible; scroll down to see all 10 collapsible sections.

steps.title: Expand Microscope Readiness to verify corpus data
steps.narration: The Microscope Readiness section shows the fixture rig's real data: exactly 1 symbol-day and 2 datasets, both PG symbols from June 9, 2026.
steps.point_out: The Corpus Totals table shows 'Distinct symbol-days: 1' and 'Distinct datasets: 2'; the Legacy Tick Shards table lists 2 PG rows, both with 'hand_assigned' provenance and 'exploratory' exposure state.

steps.title: Open the Cockpit page
steps.narration: The Cockpit is the live trading watchlist and chart. It shows no ticker by default.
steps.point_out: The text 'No ticker watched' appears, confirming the empty state.

steps.title: Watch a ticker to verify live tape still works
steps.narration: Type SIM-BUYER into the Ticker field and click Watch. The live tape rendering pipeline is unaffected by this iteration's backend changes.
steps.point_out: After clicking Watch, 'Buyer Control' appears, confirming the watch flow completes without error.

steps.title: Click Watch to activate the ticker
steps.narration: Clicking Watch confirms the cockpit's tape engine responds correctly.
steps.point_out: The text 'Buyer Control' appears, indicating the ticker watch completed successfully.

steps.title: Open the Structure page to check the Tradable Map
steps.narration: The Structure page computes support/resistance bands from historical bar data. This page's data pipeline is independent of this iteration's trade/quote storage changes.
steps.point_out: The 'Tradable Map' heading is visible on page load.

steps.title: Load AAPL's Tradable Map as of June 22, 2026
steps.narration: Fill in AAPL and the as-of date (2026-06-22 17:00:00 ET), then click Load. The band computation is byte-identical — this verifies the bar-store and structure engine remain unaffected.
steps.point_out: The text '300.11–302.2' appears, the pinned real support/resistance band for AAPL on that date. This exact band has been verified across iterations.

steps.title: Fill the as-of date and load the structure
steps.narration: Enter the target date in the as-of field, then click Load to compute the Tradable Map.
steps.point_out: The band '300.11–302.2' confirms the structure engine byte-compatibility.

steps.title: Click Load to compute the structure
Return to Desk and expand Playbook Evidence
steps.narration: Back on the Desk page, the Playbook Evidence section reads real, pre-computed playbook signals from the fixture dataset.
steps.point_out: When the section expands, 'Built from signature:' is visible, confirming a real playbook is loaded.

steps.title: Expand Playbook Evidence section
steps.narration: Open the Playbook Evidence section to verify it renders real signal data.

steps.title: Enter a date in the Playbook Evidence filter
steps.narration: Type 2026-06-22 into the date field to filter the signals for that day.
steps.point_out: The text 'recorded signals, none hidden' appears, confirming the full, unfiltered signal set is served for the selected date.

steps.title: Expand Referee Registry to verify the frozen fingerprint
steps.narration: The Referee Registry section displays the configuration fingerprint. This frozen value proves the computation engine's byte-identity.
steps.point_out: The text 'config fingerprint 08e471b10130e1e2' appears, exactly as expected.

steps.title: Verify Referee Adjudications honest-empty state
steps.narration: The Referee Adjudications section is intentionally empty — no hypotheses are registered yet. This is the correct state, not an error.

steps.title: Verify Referee Runs honest-empty state
steps.narration: The Referee Runs section also shows an honest empty state — no evaluation runs have been recorded yet.
steps.point_out: The text 'No evaluation runs recorded yet.' appears.
